quote: You carry weights you were never meant to hold. Every unsaid word lingers inside your heavy chest. You keep quiet to protect everyone else around you. But your own spirit is slowly fading away. Let the armor fall off your tired shoulders today. Peace begins the moment you finally choose yourself.
